title: Ryot Waist Pack
description:
Ryot Waist Pack
The Ryot Waist Pack or bum bag if you are old school. This can be worn around the waist or over the shoulder. This handy smell proof bag is ideal for carrying multiple vaporizers, grinder, herb and more.
The Ryot Waist Pack features a wax covered cotton canvas which gives this bag a water resistant coating for those long walks in the pouring rain. Nothing better.
Features
Ryot Odour Absorbing SmellSafe Carbon Technology. This feature goes a long way in controlling smells coming from inside your bag.
Wax Covered Cotton Canvas (provides water resistance)
Adjustable Waist Strap With Clip Closure
Dual Top SmellSafe Zip Closures
Internal Neoprene Accessory Pockets
External Front Zip Pocket
1 Year Warranty
Closed Dimensions
11″ X 6″ X 4″ (28cm X 15cm X 10cm)
Please Note: Accessories shown in accessory pockets NOT included.
Included
1 x Ryot Waist Pack
